summary: First-finish smoke test of CRS Maslahat. Backend auth + core endpoints healthy (all 4 roles login, /api/auth/me, /api/dashboard/stats, /api/contracts return valid JSON; 10 seeded contracts). Frontend: login, admin dashboard KPIs, repository table, detail Sheet with Metadata/Versi/Audit tabs, role-based sidebar (legal_officer hides nav-submit, admin+business_unit show it), logout, submit form load, Panduan Legal modal with Wajib/Risiko/Solusi matrix, and both FABs (fab-report, fab-help) all render correctly. File-upload flows (docx submit, signed PDF) and Legal status transitions (Setujui / Minta Revisi) not exercised in this pass and are deferred to full QA.
passed: Backend: admin/business_unit/legal_officer login returns JWT (field name is 'token')
Backend: GET /api/auth/me returns admin profile with role='admin'
Backend: GET /api/dashboard/stats returns {total_active, pending_verification, expiring_soon, expired}
Backend: GET /api/contracts returns 10 seeded contracts with expected fields (contract_id, partner_name, institution_type, status, etc.)
Frontend: /login page loads with all demo buttons and login form
Frontend: admin login redirects to dashboard, KPI cards render for all 4 metrics
Frontend: repository table renders 10 rows (view-{id} buttons present)
Frontend: contract detail Sheet opens; tab-metadata, tab-versions, tab-audit all switch
Frontend: fab-report and fab-help visible on authenticated pages
Frontend: role-based sidebar — legal_officer does NOT see nav-submit (count=0); admin & business_unit DO see nav-submit
Frontend: logout via user-menu-trigger + logout-btn clears session and redirects to /login
Frontend: /submit form loads with all f-* fields for business_unit
Frontend: Panduan Legal modal opens showing full matrix (Nama Dokumen / Kategori / Syarat Mutlak / Risiko / Solusi) for the selected institution type (Yayasan)

failed.issue: Typing 'Yayasan' in search-input did not reduce row count (still 10). Either all 10 seeded contracts contain the term or the search filter is not applying. Needs deeper verification in full QA.
Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle warning in console for Panduan Legal modal (accessibility only, not functional).
failed.evidence: CON[error]: `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.

action_items: Verify search-input actually filters the contracts list (likely all seeded contracts matched 'Yayasan'; try a distinctive term to confirm)
(Optional) Add a visually hidden DialogTitle to the Panduan Legal Dialog to silence a11y warning

Full QA pass should still exercise: docx upload during PKS submission, Legal Officer approval/revision transitions on under_legal_review contract, signed PDF upload on ready_for_signature contract, download via /api/files/{id}?token=, admin /users page, and management role dashboard
